runtime_policy: Offline stdlib Python using release CSVs only. Workspace source paths below are provenance only, not runtime inputs.

sources.excluded_reason: Other competition levels are outside main Table V.
Other competition levels are outside main Table V.

sources.version_rationale: Formal wiring-2 Chinese full run; no smoke or wiring1.
Formal matching-language full-run window labels; English uses corrected coverage variant. No window text copied.
Formal full-run English wiring-2.1 coverage-corrected version; detector labels unchanged, no smoke or stale coverage fields.
Formal matching-language full-run window labels; English uses corrected coverage variant. No window text copied.

table5.original_batch: E17 selected valid final episodes, batch=m-base; archived failed attempts are not episodes.csv rows.
table5.concurrent_batch: E17mg selected valid final episodes, batch=mg-base; independent run batch, never pooled with original Fully merged.

first_request_delivery.concurrent_memorygraft: first_ge1 (at least one complete experience record in the FIRST model request)

table5.execution_outcome: int(target_executions)>0; cross-checked against source p3 during extraction
table5.discarded_columns: Raw run paths, service/account metadata, config signatures, timestamps, costs and unnecessary fields are omitted.

table6.source_id: platform_scenario_case_episode; identical across paired zh/en versions
table6.n_memory_records: n_mem_entries; zero-memory sources retained in release and excluded dynamically from both memory-scan denominators. Source *_no_memory is True for empty sources and blank otherwise; verified at extraction.
table6.saved_per_record_positive: {lang}_pg_mem_windows_detected; validation only, not used to calculate the table count
table6.per_record_positive: Window label_id==1; any positive window within a record, then any positive record within source. Each record has one window in these data, checked at runtime.
table6.discarded_columns: All window texts, request/record text, detector floating scores, LG outputs, coverage metadata and account/path metadata omitted.

exclusions.rule: n_memory_records == 0 excludes source from both memory-scan fractions, not from CSV inventory
exclusions.pairing: Same source identities retained for Chinese and English; languages are paired measurements, not independent episodes.
